title: 申万宏源蒋静：当前美债收益率4.5%是买入良机
speaker: Jinsheng Jing

segments.en: One thing is that I think from the short-term rate perspective, as I expect, there will be only like zero or at one time the most rate hike for the fact this year.
segments.zh: 从短期利率角度看，我预计今年美联储最多加息一次，甚至不加息。

segments.en: And with this breaking news, I think the pressure has go down to only zero times rate hike. So from the short-term rate point of view, we don't see there is a much pressure going up.
segments.zh: 加上这一突发消息，我认为加息压力已降至零。所以从短期利率角度看，我们看不到上行压力。

segments.en: And also from the risk of premium perspective, because this year we don't see there is a lot of pressure on more US deficit, US physical deficit going up.
segments.zh: 从风险溢价角度看，今年我们看不到美国赤字大幅增加的压力。

segments.en: And also, I think when Kevin Worsh actually go on the Fed board, he would not implement the so-called balance sheet reduction very quickly, because that is more like a systematic work to do.
segments.zh: 而且，我认为当沃什进入美联储董事会后，他不会很快实施所谓的缩表，因为这更像是一项系统性工作。

segments.en: So from the premium side, I think the risk is controllable. So at this current level, like 4.5 US Treasuries, I think the rate is high, and the duration rate risk is generally controllable.
segments.zh: 所以从溢价角度看，风险可控。在当前4.5%的水平，我认为收益率较高，久期风险总体可控。

segments.en: So that's what I think that is a good price to buy.
segments.zh: 所以我认为这是一个好的买入价格。
